description.narrative: The objective of the GEF PPG is to develop the project concept into a full project: [Introduction of climate smart agricultural (CSA) technologies in the District of Coronie to increase climate resilience.]. As described in the project concept (PIF/child project concept note), this project aims to work in Coronie, the driest district in Suriname to: i) Create awareness between the link of land use and water management to support planning processes in the face of climate change ii) Build capacity for climate resilience by providing technical support to farmers in Coronie to strengthen understanding of climate risks, adaptation strategies, and livelihood opportunities; iii) Enhance water resource management by developing sustainable water collection and storage systems, such as rainwater harvesting, improved irrigation, and groundwater replenishment, to mitigate the impacts of prolonged drought; and iv) Further strengthen agricultural resilience through the adoption of climate-adaptive practices, including the introduction of saline and drought-resistant crop varieties, innovative irrigation technologies, and bioeconomy strategies that diversify incomes while being compatible with local hydrological processes that are vital to manage drought and saline intrusion.

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
